description: Ranz-Marshall forced-convection mass-transfer correlation for a single sphere, as stated

description: Pure-diffusion limit of the Ranz-Marshall correlation (Re -> 0, no buoyant convection, e.g. quiescent microgravity)
notes: My arithmetic: setting Re=0 in Eq. [8] gives Sh=2 (conduction/diffusion to an isolated sphere in an infinite medium). Mass-transfer coefficient k = Sh*D/d. A sealed chamber of finite size is not an infinite medium - treat as lower bound.

description: Natural (free) convection from an isothermal sphere - Churchill correlation as stated (laminar)

An OA paper (Sanchez-Garcia et al. 2024, PMC11490890) renders this equation with exponent 9/6 and no 4/9 power - a typo; do not copy from there. In 0 g, Gr=0 so this term vanishes.

description: Chapman-Enskog kinetic-theory form of binary gas diffusion coefficient (explicit 1/P dependence)

quote: increase in length by approximately 100-fold, as compared with those in the embryo
notes: SECONDARY: citing Gendreau et al. 1997 and Refregier et al. 2004.

quote: elongation growth of this organ does not involve significant cortical or epidermal cell divisions
notes: Full text exists only as a scanned PDF (PMC158305) behind a browser proof-of-work download page - not retrieved. Abstract gives no numbers; use SEED_HYP_* meta-analysis rows or have a person extract values from the PDF.

source_short: Li et al. 2024 Int J Mol Sci
quote: significantly longer than the hypocotyl of Col-0 seedlings (11.83 ± 0.74 mm)
notes: ACC-treated (0.1-50 uM) lengths are shown only in Fig. 1B/D (not extracted); 25 uM ACC effect ~ 50 uM per text.

notes: Guzman & Ecker full text is a scanned PDF (PMC159907) not retrieved (same proof-of-work barrier). No numeric hook angle found in accessible text.

description: Ethylene overproduction by eto1 vs wild type
quote: were found to produce at least 40 times more ethylene than the wild type
notes: Also registered under JSTOR DOI 10.2307/3869113 (both resolve in Crossref).

description: Maximum root gravitropic response rate, wild type held at constant tip angle
conditions: Root restrained at constant angle on vertical rotating stage
quote: a maximum response rate approaching 30° h−1
notes: SECONDARY: cites Wolverton et al. 2011 (not read). pgm-1 starchless: constant 8 deg h-1. Not the same as free bending after a single 90 deg turn.

description: Col-0 root bending rate (deg h-1) after a single 90 deg reorientation (free response)
notes: Canaday et al. 2026 ran this assay (4-d seedlings, 15 deg h-1 rotation variant) but values are in figures only.

description: Lowest centrifugal g at which Col-0 roots reached the full 1 g gravitropic phenotype (ISS EMCS)
conditions: ISS European Modular Cultivation System centrifuge, 0.003-1 g
quote: Wild-type roots reached a full 1 g response at only 0.011 g
notes: pgm-1 needed >= 0.38 g.

description: Minimum pO2 for normal germination; time to radicle protrusion
source_short: Park & Hasenstein 2016 Life Sci Space Res
quote: protrusion of radicle about 18 hours after imbibition
notes: Lower pO2 delayed and reduced germination; anoxia 3 d -> no germination (75% after return to air). Not Arabidopsis.

description: Differentially expressed genes after 24 h at 10 kPa vs 101 kPa
conditions: 9-10-d plate-grown plants; 10 kPa Earth-normal air (CO2 held 0.1 kPa); 22 C; 24 h
quote: resulted in the significant differential expression of more than 200 genes
notes: pO2 at 10 kPa air ~2.1 kPa (my arithmetic, 20.95% O2). Fewer than half of hypobaria-induced genes were also induced by 2% O2 at 101 kPa; many ABA/drought-related.

description: Hypobaria/hypoxia separation treatments (total pressure / pO2)
conditions: 24 h; 10-d seedlings (5-d for some) on vertical plates
source_short: Zhou et al. 2017 Front Plant Sci
quote: 50 kPa/pO2 = 10 kPa, 25 kPa/pO2 = 5 kPa, 50 kPa/pO2 = 21 kPa
notes: Design values. Source reports no desiccation phenotype in any treatment (Fig. legend).

description: Net photosynthesis response to total pressure 101 -> 10 kPa
value: increased when ppCO2 < 0.04 kPa; insensitive at 0.07-0.10 kPa
quote: P (net) increased as the pressures decreased from 101 to 10 kPa
notes: Authors: plant modules 'might be operated around 10 kPa'.

description: Reduction of ethylene production rate at 30 kPa vs 101 kPa
conditions: 10-d study, 28-d lettuce and 40-d wheat transplanted into chambers
source_short: He et al. 2003 J Plant Physiol
quote: reduced more than 65% under 30 kPa compared with ambient pressure (101 kPa)
notes: pO2 6.2 kPa inhibited lettuce ethylene at both pressures; wheat inhibited by low pressure but not low O2. 'The hypobaric effect on reduced ethylene production was greater than that of just hypoxia'.

description: Germination rate and growth at 50 kPa vs 101 kPa (direct-seeded, 28 d)
source_short: He et al. 2003 J Plant Physiol
quote: Hypobaria increased plant growth and did not alter germination rate.
notes: No numbers in abstract.

description: Effect of hypobaria (25 kPa) on endogenous ethylene production
conditions: 25 vs 101 kPa; pCO2 100 Pa; ethylene 0 to ~1000 ppb
quote: hypobaria caused no significant reduction of endogenous ethylene production
notes: CONTRASTS with He et al. 2003 (>65% reduction at 30 kPa). Negative linear relation of ethylene (0 to ~1000 nmol mol-1) with CO2 assimilation, dark respiration and growth.

description: Seed germination under hypobaria (25 kPa) and hypoxia (6 kPa pO2)
value: not reduced by 25 kPa; reduced by 6 kPa pO2
conditions: Seed to harvest 32 d; 25 or 101 kPa
quote: Seed germination was not adversely affected by hypobaria, but was reduced by hypoxia (6 kPa pO(2))
notes: Under hypoxia, germination higher at hypobaria than ambient total pressure. Significant endogenous ethylene by day 15.

description: Root growth reduction at 6 kPa pO2
conditions: 25 or 101 kPa total; 6, 12, 21 kPa pO2; pCO2 100 Pa
quote: Roots were most sensitive to hypoxia, with a 50-70% growth reduction.
notes: Hypobaria itself (25 kPa at adequate pO2) did not reduce growth or CO2 assimilation.

description: Germination/emergence and growth at 70 kPa with pO2 held at 21 kPa
value: no detriment (growth at least as rapid)
conditions: 70 vs ~101 kPa; pCO2 66.5-73.5 Pa; first 5 d germination + 30-d growth; 66-L chamber
quote: shoot and root growth was at least as rapid as at ambient pressure
notes: Dark respiration greater at low pressure.

description: Statement that low total pressure enhances gas diffusion (spinach gas exchange)
conditions: 25 kPa total, constant pO2 and pCO2
quote: not stimulated even with the enhancement of gas diffusion because the stomatal size and stomatal aperture decreased
notes: Short-term exposure raised CO2 assimilation and transpiration via higher leaf conductance; long-term-grown plants compensated with smaller stomata.

description: Statement that pressure changes alter diffusion rates and boundary layers in plant habitats
quote: Changes in pressure affect gas diffusion rates and surface boundary layers
notes: Also: increased evapotranspiration at reduced pressure even at constant VPD.

description: Wheat dry mass at 200 -> 100 hPa total pressure (O2-enriched, CO2 2-3x) vs control
conditions: 200 hPa (pO2 170 hPa) for 22 d then 100 hPa (pO2 79 hPa) to harvest
quote: final dry mass increased by 76%
notes: Authors attribute partly to elevated CO2; shoot shortening attributed to N2 removal/altered gas diffusion.

description: Arabidopsis germination timing or seedling growth rate at reduced total pressure
notes: Paul 2004, Richards 2006 and Zhou 2017 used pre-grown plants (transcriptome/photosynthesis), not germination. Strickland et al. 2026 Plant Direct (doi:10.1002/pld3.70190, cell-wall polysaccharides under hypobaria) found by search but not read.

description: Published statement that low total pressure enhances ethylene removal from plant chambers
notes: He et al. 2003 report reduced ethylene PRODUCTION at 30 kPa; He et al. 2009 report no reduction at 25 kPa. No source read states enhanced removal/venting. Faster gas-phase diffusion at low P (D ~ 1/P) is physics, not a measured removal rate.
